item.title: Viewpoints: Lynn Blakey, Somewhere in the Stars
item.description: I have passed the days since Lynn Blakey’s death on Friday alternating between grief and rage. Grief because a kinder soul has never walked this earth, and rage at the cosmic injustice of her painful end from cancer at age 63. It all just seems so unfair. The post Viewpoints: Lynn Blakey, Somewhere in the Stars appeared first on Chapelboro.com.
